baseline.reason: The intro commit (b8bf2f4e) broke common_init() in libavfilter/buffersink.c: after calling av_realloc_array() to grow buf->channel_layouts, the result was stored in local variable `tmp` but never written back to buf->channel_layouts. On the first iteration buf->channel_layouts is NULL, so the subsequent memset(&buf->channel_layouts[buf->nb_channel_layouts], ...) writes to address 0x0. Running ffmpeg with the deprecated ch_layouts option on an abuffersink filter triggers the path. pre_intro exits
